item.text: I’ll assess the supplied records only and submit one decision for each profile, then confirm their recorded status.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc './submit_profile "Martin Härter" accept "Universität Hamburg profile is a coherent mental-health, patient-centred communication and quality-of-life record, including SDM-Q-9 psychometrics and health-systems/QoL work consistent with the EQ-5D project." && ./submit_profile "Martine Hoogendoorn" accept "Erasmus MC profile centres on COPD and health economics and includes the exact 2021 EQ-5D-5L Plus Respiratory Bolt-On Birmingham COPD Cohort paper, directly matching both respiratory bolt-on projects." && ./submit_profile "Marufa Sultana" accept "Deakin University profile coherently covers Bangladeshi child health, healthcare use and health economics/quality of life, consistent with the Bangladesh child and EQ-TIPS/EQ-5D-Y projects." && ./submit_profile "María Belizán" accept "IECS profile has a coherent Argentine health-outcomes and maternal-health record, including EQ-HWB development, EQ-HWB psychometric work, and 2026 Argentinean EQ-HWB-9 content validity." && ./submit_profile "Matthijs Versteegh" accept "Profile is a coherent Dutch health-economics and EQ-5D valuation record: it includes the Dutch EQ-5D-5L tariff, time trade-off research, mapping to EQ-5D, and frequent coauthorship with Simone Huygens." && ./submit_profile status'
